Tell me about a technical decision other.why: They want evidence that you can influence others and handle disagreement.
Tell me about a technical decision other.mistake: Telling a story where you were simply right and others eventually saw it.
Tell me about a technical decision other.followUp: What would you do differently next time?

Describe a production incident you cause.why: It tests ownership and what you learned.
Describe a production incident you cause.mistake: Blaming someone else or picking a trivial incident.
Describe a production incident you cause.followUp: How did you make sure it didn't happen again?

How do you mentor junior developers?.why: Senior engineers are expected to raise the team's level.
How do you mentor junior developers?.mistake: Describing mentoring in general terms, with no person or outcome.
How do you mentor junior developers?.followUp: How did you know the mentoring worked?

How do you handle tech debt?.why: To see whether you connect engineering work to business impact.
How do you handle tech debt?.mistake: Asking for a rewrite because the code is ugly.
How do you handle tech debt?.followUp: How did you get time for the work?

How do you do code reviews?.why: Reviews show how you work with other people.
How do you do code reviews?.mistake: Focusing on style nits that tools should catch.
How do you do code reviews?.followUp: How do you handle a disagreement in a review?

Tell me about a time you pushed back on.why: They're checking how you handle conflict with non-engineers.
Tell me about a time you pushed back on.mistake: Either refusing outright or agreeing and quietly missing the date.
Tell me about a time you pushed back on.followUp: What did you learn about the product side?

What makes a developer senior rather tha.why: It reveals how you see your own responsibility.
What makes a developer senior rather tha.mistake: Answering with years of experience or a list of technologies.
What makes a developer senior rather tha.followUp: Give an example from your own work.
